page.title: Places
page.description: Every room inside and every zone outside. Tasks, stock and shopping hang off them.

sections.outsideDescription: Garden, driveway, shed and everything else outdoors.

empty.title: No places yet
empty.description: Start with a ground floor and the outside, then list your rooms. Drawing them is optional.
empty.outsideDescription: Add it for the garden, the driveway, the shed or the jacuzzi.

form.description: Each floor, and the outside, gets its own plan.
form.levelHelp: 0 is the ground floor, -1 the basement.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Its floor plan is deleted too. This can't be undone.
delete.hasPlaces: Move or delete its places first.

empty.indoor: No rooms on this floor yet.

form.description: A room inside or a zone outside. You can draw it on the plan later.
form.floorHelp: Moving it to another floor removes its outline from the old plan.
form.iconHelp: An emoji, shown in lists and on the plan.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: It disappears from the list and the plan. This can't be undone.

detail.contentsDescription: Everything linked to this place shows up here.

shopping.title: Shopping
shopping.empty: Nothing to buy for this place.

detail.notDrawn: Not drawn on the plan of {{floor}} yet.

picker.favoriteFailed: Couldn't update your favourites. Try again.

description.indoor: Draw the rooms, walls, doors and windows. Rooms you listed but haven't drawn are in the tools window.
description.outdoor: Draw the zones outside: garden, driveway, terrace, shed…

editor.overlapsHint: Overlaps detected: {{count}}. You can adjust the drawing or save it with these overlaps.
editor.wallOverlap: Walls {{first}} and {{second}} overlap or cross inside one another.
editor.saveInvalid: The plan couldn't be saved. Check it and try again.
editor.finishDraftFirst: Finish or clear the shape you're drawing first
editor.nameRequired: Every place needs a name before saving.
editor.smallScreen: Editing the plan works on a larger screen. You can still look around and open places.

panel.label: Tools
panel.expand: Show labels in the tools window
panel.shortcuts: V select · R draw · F fill room · W wall (X flips the side) · D door · N window · Enter finish · Esc cancel · Del delete · Ctrl+Z undo · Alt free placement · Space+drag pan

fill.title: Fill room
fill.labels: Names come from the plan's room labels.
fill.gapTolerance: Close gaps between walls up to
fill.open_one: This area isn't closed: {{count}} open wall end is marked in red.
fill.open_other: This area isn't closed: {{count}} open wall ends are marked in red.
fill.outside: That's outside every room. Click inside walls that form a closed room.
fill.onWall: That's a wall. Click inside the room.
fill.noWalls: Draw the walls first (W), then fill the rooms.

underlay.title: Architect's plan
underlay.empty: Import a PDF or image of the plan, set its scale and trace over it: lengths and areas follow by themselves.
underlay.lockedHint: Locked: clicks go to the drawing.
underlay.unlockedHint: Unlocked: drag it with Select to line it up.
underlay.removed: Plan removed from the drawing. The file stays in Documents.
underlay.imageFailed: The plan image couldn't be loaded.

calibrate.title: Set the scale
calibrate.hint: Click two points whose real distance you know, e.g. both ends of a dimension line or a long wall. Drag the ends to adjust, zoom in for precision.
calibrate.measures: This line measures {{length}} on the plan now.
calibrate.formats: Metres (12,00 m), centimetres (1200 cm) or as on the plan (1.200 = 12 m).
calibrate.drawingScaleHint: For PDFs exported to scale. Check with the line: it should measure what the plan says.

import.title: Import a plan
import.description: A PDF (or PNG/JPG) of the plan of {{floor}}. The file is kept in Documents.
import.pagesDescription: Which page has the plan of this floor?
import.cropDescription: Drag a rectangle around the drawing of this floor, e.g. the ground floor in its new state.
import.dropDescription: PDF, PNG or JPG. Vector PDFs from the architect work best.
import.privacy: Plans often show names, addresses and phone numbers. The file stays in your household's Documents.
import.wrongType: Choose a PDF, PNG or JPG file.
import.unreadable: This file couldn't be opened. Is it a valid PDF or image?
import.sourceMissing: The original file isn't in Documents any more. Choose it again.
import.tooLarge: This file is too large to store in Documents.

stage.render: Rendering the plan in high resolution…

import.cropHint: Drag around one drawing. Ctrl + scroll zooms.
import.cropSelected: Drag again to change the selection.
import.done: Plan imported. Set its scale next.

place.vertices_one: {{count}} point. Drag points to adjust, drag an edge's dot to add one.
place.vertices_other: {{count}} points. Drag points to adjust, drag an edge's dot to add one.

hints.select: Click a shape to edit it. Drag empty space to move around, scroll to zoom.
hints.outline: Click to add points. Click the first point, double-click or press Enter to close the shape.
hints.wall: Click to start, click again for every corner. Double-click, Enter or Esc to stop.
hints.wallFace: Click along the architect's line: the wall grows to the side shown in the preview. X flips the side.
hints.fill: Click inside walls to add a room along their inner faces. Doors and windows don't leak.
hints.door: Click on a wall to put a door there.
hints.window: Click on a wall to put a window there.
hints.dragOpening: Drag it along its wall to move it.
hints.openingNeedsWall: Doors and windows go in a wall. Click on a wall.
hints.wallTooShort: This wall is too short for that width.

markers.paletteHint: Drag onto the plan, or choose “Place on the plan” and tap a spot. Move a placed marker by dragging it, or select it and use the arrow keys (Shift: bigger steps).
markers.placing: Tap or click a spot on the plan to place “{{label}}”. Esc cancels.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.degrees: North, in degrees clockwise from the top of the plan
orientation.topFaces: The top of the plan faces
orientation.hint: One north for the whole house, used on every floor and for the sun. You can also drag the compass on the plan.
orientation.compassValue: North {{degrees}}°, the top of the plan faces {{facing}}
orientation.dialHint: Drag to turn north (Shift: 15° steps), or use the arrow keys

tool.title: Point north
tool.hint: Click the tail of the architect's north arrow, then its tip. Zoom in for precision; the plan's rotation is taken into account.
tool.hintNoPlan: Click two points along a line that points north: first the tail, then the tip.
tool.result: North points {{degrees}}° from the top: the top of the plan faces {{direction}}. Click again to start over.
tool.done: North set to {{degrees}}°. Save the plan to keep it.

view.sunAt: Sun in the {{direction}} ({{azimuth}}°), {{elevation}}° above the horizon
view.belowHorizon: The sun is below the horizon.

planDiff.label: Floor plan of {{floor}} with the proposed change
planDiff.invalid: The preview of this change can't be shown.
